summary:
This brief reads the fact layer generated at 2026-11-09T22:28:41Z, which is 17:28 EST, 88 minutes after the 16:00 ET close, so US equities and all 22 sector and theme rows are settled 2026-11-09 closes; Beijing time is already the morning of 11-10, so the China A-share block is also the settled 2026-11-09 close, with all 11 daily bars carrying a valid close and no repeat of the post-market null-close defect seen in earlier runs. Total risk 66.88 stays high_risk with regime=risk_off for a 3rd consecutive session; against 68.90 on 2026-11-06 that is down 2.02, while the published trend_1d of down 3.64 is the gap to today's 12:36Z pre-market generation at 70.52, not a day-over-day move.

The session was a broad, breadth-led repair: all 22 rows rose for a mean of 4.6788 and a median of 4.2474, led by semiconductor equipment at 9.7228, networking at 9.3246 and the semiconductor ETF proxy at 7.4929, with fintech the laggard at 1.0509. Of the 5 tracked US names, 4 rose; the only decliner was NVDA, down 4.2703 to 178.669998 as the board opened an independent investigation into reports concerning Jensen Huang. AMD gained 13.2594, AVGO 8.7814 and MU 6.2536, leaving the equal-weight semis sector up 6.006. China went the other way, with 4 of 11 names up for a mean of down 0.4856.

The decline is structural repair rather than a repricing of level risks: breadth rose from 0.2645 to 0.3419 (41 to 53 of 155 names), the new-low ratio fell from 0.0828 to 0.0382, the trend dimension went from 57.96 to 52.85 and cross-asset from 62.50 back to 50.00, together giving back about 3.64, while macro added 0.25 in the other direction. But liquidity and credit at 76.81, macro at 73.76 and volatility at 71.80 still pin the total inside high_risk, with high-yield OAS at 3.42, the real rate at 2.63 and the 10-year at 4.86 all in high percentiles. Timing caveat: rates, credit, FX and VIX stop at 2026-11-06 (VIX 25.64 is that session's close, so no 2026-11-09 volatility is in the score), reverse repo at 0.252 and inflation expectations are 2026-11-09, and the Fed balance sheet is 2026-11-04. The regime_evidence string VIX 25.6 ≥ 28 is not true; the actual risk_off trigger is breadth 0.3419 ≤ 0.35. CLS and Wall Street CN items are RSSHub relays (trust: relay) and are treated as second-hand aggregation only.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Liquidity and credit at 76.81 is the largest level-based dimension holding the total in high_risk: high-yield OAS 3.42 sits at the 87.63 percentile, investment grade OAS is 0.93 and reverse repo at 0.252 scores 95.02 on risk. These are FRED level prints that a one-day rally cannot release. The dimension is down 1.29 from 78.10 on 2026-11-06, giving back just 0.258 points.

The volatility dimension at 71.80 combines VIX 25.64 at the 87.30 percentile with 20-day realized volatility of 22.0418. VIX is the 2026-11-06 close, one session behind, so no 2026-11-09 implied volatility has entered the layer while realized volatility has already risen to 22.0418. The dimension is down only 0.82 from 72.62 on 2026-11-06 and cannot be read as same-day volatility risk being resolved.

Macro at 73.76 is still a floor under the score: the real rate 2.63 sits at the 97.67 percentile, the 10-year 4.86 at the 92.78 percentile, the 2-year at 4.51 and the dollar index at 121.8803. The first two are level indicators, and the CPI and PPI tests do not arrive until 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-13. Rate prints stop at 2026-11-06 and must not be described as today's rates.

Equity structure fell from 71.67 to 66.05, but breadth 0.3419 (53 of 155 names) is still below the 0.35 risk_off threshold, with new lows 0.0382 against new highs 0.0446; on a 63 trading day basis small caps remain 3.8206 weaker and semiconductors 15.2623 weaker. One broad up day has moved breadth only from 0.2645 to 0.3419 and has not changed the regime.

Cross-asset confirmation at 0.50 is 4 of 8 legs triggered, one fewer than 0.625 in today's 12:36Z pre-market layer: the only leg that flipped is the 24 hour bitcoin leg, from down 1.81108 to up 0.72866, which took the cross-asset dimension from 62.50 back to 50.00 for a 1.875 point contribution. Still triggered are dollar strength 121.8803, real-rate pressure 2.63, gold up and small caps 3.8206 weaker on a 63 trading day basis.

supporting_signals.claim: All 22 sector and theme rows closed higher, with a mean of 4.6788 and a median of 4.2474, led by semiconductor equipment 9.7228, networking 9.3246 and the semiconductor ETF proxy 7.4929, while the weakest, fintech, still gained 1.0509. Every one of the 22 rows' 1d series reproduces to 4 decimal places from either the equal-weight constituents or the ETF's own close, with a full last-step intersection and no timezone degradation.

NVDA fell 4.2703 to 178.669998, the only decline among the 5 tracked US names, while the semis sector (equal weight NVDA, AVGO, MU, AMD) still gained 6.006 and the SOXX proxy 7.4929. That is consistent with the governance-investigation news shock and shows the sector advance was not led by Nvidia.

Breadth rose from 0.2645 to 0.3419 (41 to 53 of 155 names), the new-low ratio fell from 0.0828 to 0.0382 (13 to 6 of 157) and the new-high ratio rose from 0.0127 to 0.0446. These three are the main source of the 2.02 decline in the total risk score, with the equity structure dimension down from 71.47 to 66.05.

contradicting_signals.claim: A session in which all 22 rows rose and 4 tracked US names gained still leaves the regime at risk_off and the total at 66.88 in high_risk, because breadth 0.3419 remains below the 0.35 threshold and the three level dimensions carry substantial weight. One day of price direction contradicts the model state, so the rebound should not be read as a downgrade.

VIX 25.64 is the 2026-11-06 close, rates and credit are also 2026-11-06, the Fed balance sheet is 2026-11-04, while equities and sectors are the 2026-11-09 close. The 66.88 therefore mixes vintages across 3 trading days, and the 2.02 decline cannot be attributed entirely to today's tape.

Only 4 of the 11 China A-share names rose, for a mean of down 0.4856, with 300223.SZ the worst at down 1.8726, against the US tape with all 22 rows up. The A-share block is the settled 2026-11-09 close rather than a stale session, so this is a genuine regional divergence, not a data defect.

watch_next: CPI at 2026-11-10 13:30Z is the nearest test: the 10-year 4.86 sits at the 92.78 percentile and the real rate 2.63 at the 97.67 percentile, so a hot print would push both higher. Chinese relay items suggest the October CPI may lack a year-on-year figure; that is second-hand aggregation and the official release governs.
Whether volatility gives back: 71.80 rests on the 2026-11-06 VIX of 25.64 and will be repriced in one step when the 2026-11-09 print lands; 20-day realized volatility at 22.0418 is the reference.
Whether breadth clears 0.35: the current 0.3419 is 53 of 155 names and the risk_off regime rests on this one gate alone; further repair changes the state call, otherwise it holds.

Whether the Nvidia story spreads: NVDA fell 4.2703 while the semis sector gained 6.006 and the 63 trading day semiconductor relative gap of 15.2623 persists; NVDA earnings on 2026-11-17 are the next single-name test.

Credit is the highest-leverage falsifier: high-yield OAS 3.42 is 0.58 below the 4 widening threshold, and crossing it would lift the liquidity and credit dimension and the cross-asset widening leg together.

bull_case.title: Bull case: breadth clears 0.35 and volatility gives back
points: Breadth repairs from 0.3419 above 0.35, removing the only real risk_off gate; if the 2026-11-09 VIX print comes in below 25.64, volatility at 71.80 gives back more points.
High-yield OAS holds near 3.42 without widening and liquidity and credit at 76.81 rolls over.
The broad 22-row advance continues, and a breadth-led tape near the 4.6788 mean keeps pushing the 52.85 trend dimension lower.

base_case.title: Base case: range around 66.88 with high_risk intact
points: The three level dimensions, liquidity and credit 76.81, macro 73.76 and volatility 71.80, pin the score high; a single up day can only move the structural dimension.
Rates, credit and VIX stay on the 2026-11-06 print, so the score's reaction to today waits for the next vintage.
Weak China with 4 of 11 names up coexists with the US tape with all 22 rows up, keeping the regional divergence.

bear_case.title: Bear case: credit confirms and the score turns back up
points: High-yield OAS crosses 4, lifting liquidity and credit at 76.81 and the cross-asset widening leg together.
Breadth retreats from 0.3419 and the new-low ratio rises from 0.0382, making risk_off more firmly established.
The Nvidia governance shock spreads into AI hardware, the 63 trading day semiconductor relative gap widens beyond 15.2623, and the 4.2703 NVDA decline stops being a single-name event.
